# Sober Bar & Kitchen

> We serve non-alcoholic drinks. Some NA beers contain trace alcohol below 0.5% ABV.

- Address: 3062 Beach Blvd S, Gulfport, FL 33707
- Phone: (813) 586-1660
- Email: Sean@sipsoberbar.com
- Hours: Sunday–Thursday 7am–10pm · Friday–Saturday 7am–midnight
- Online booking is dinner, 4–9:30pm, and Sunday brunch, 10am–1pm. Daytime is walk-in.
- Online booking is for parties of 1–6. For 7 or more, call (813) 586-1660.
- Friday and Saturday close at midnight.
- Live jazz every Sunday brunch. Call (813) 586-1660 for this Sunday's jazz time. No band or start time is published.
- Reserve dinner: https://getseat.net?channel=merchant_web&productId=101287#/public/online/reservation/8B932637
- Reserve Sunday brunch: https://getseat.net?channel=merchant_web&productId=101285#/public/online/reservation/8B932637

## Menu
### Cocktails
- Call Me an Ube: Ritual gin alt, ube, coconut cream, key lime, pineapple
- Hot Mami: Reposado tequila alt, jalapeño, lime, pineapple ginger, chili
- Jinn & Juniper: Gin alt, cucumber, juniper, ashwagandha — crisp and garden-fresh
- Red Widow: Bourbon alt, tart cherry, lemon, honey — a dark, silky sour
- Bee's Bouquet: Gin alt, fresh lemon, honey, lavender — bright and floral
- Moonlit Meringue: Gin alt, NA limoncello, egg white, lavender bitters — cloud-soft
- Espresso Martini: Reposado tequila alt, cold brew espresso, agave, fig & walnut bitters
### Beer & Kombucha
- Run Wild IPA: Crisp, hoppy, citrus-forward NA IPA · 16 oz draft · <0.5% ABV
- Guinness 0.0: Smooth, roasted coffee and chocolate notes
- Heineken 0.0: Crisp, clean, and lightly malty
- Beech Kombucha: Bright, sparkling fermented tea on draft
### Coffee
- Cortado: Espresso with a small pour of steamed milk
- Cappuccino: Espresso, steamed milk, and a thick cap of foam
- Americano: Espresso and hot water
- Café au Lait: Hot coffee and steamed milk — a New Orleans classic
- Latte: Espresso and steamed milk, smooth and creamy
- Mocha: Espresso, chocolate, and steamed milk
- Kyoto Cold Brew: Slow-dripped with a clean, smooth finish
- Nitro Cold Brew: Cascading nitro pour, naturally creamy
- Chai Latte: Spiced chai with steamed milk
### Breakfast
- The Classic Morning Melt: English muffin, egg, American cheese, bacon, sausage, or ham
- The Beach Blvd Bodega: Everything bagel, egg, American cheese, choice of meat
- The White Rabbit: Plain bagel, egg, brie, fig spread, prosciutto, hot honey
- The Mad Hatter: English muffin or bagel, egg, everything bacon, choice of meat, provolone, tomato, spinach, pesto
- Breakfast Muffuletta: Toasted focaccia, pesto cream cheese, egg, sausage, bacon, smoked provolone
- Hot Honey Breakfast Flatbread: Pesto cream cheese, mozzarella, sausage, bacon, egg, hot honey drizzle
- Bagel & Cream Cheese: Plain or everything — house ube, fig & honey, or vegan spreads
- Yogurt Parfait: Greek yogurt, raw honey, mixed berries, Ryker's Granola
### Kitchen
- The Muffuletta: Genoa salami, capicola, mozzarella, olive salad, basil pesto, toasted focaccia
- Hot Honey Soppressata Flatbread: Whipped ricotta, mozzarella, spicy soppressata, hot honey
- Fig, Brie & Prosciutto Flatbread: Brie, fig jam, prosciutto, toasted pecans, arugula, hot honey
- Garden Mezze Flatbread: Hummus, roasted red peppers, pickled onion, balsamic-agave — plant-based
- Garden District Muffuletta: Vegan pesto, olive tapenade, roasted peppers, sourdough — plant-based
- Goat Cheese Berry Salad: Mixed greens, fresh berries, toasted pecans, goat cheese
- Spicy Mardi Gras Salad: Greens, hot capicola, Genoa salami, egg, blue cheese
- Pretzel Bites: Soft-baked, with spicy beer cheese
- Naan Dippers: Warm naan, roasted red pepper hummus, carrots, celery
